candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]=0;` so the caller's balance is never zeroed after a successful withdrawal.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]=0;` with `balances[msg.sender]=1;` so after a withdrawal the balance is set to 1 instead of 0 (and differs further for any caller whose balance was not 1).
Remove the zeroing of the caller's balance after the payout, so balances survive a withdraw.
Zero the balance before sending funds instead of after, so a reentrant call from msg.sender observes a zero balance.
Replace the balance reset with a credit equal to msg.value, so the balance is not cleared on withdraw.
Invert the guard condition so the modifier requires the lock to be held, making every withdraw revert.
Remove the lock flag initialization/check line, deleting the reentrancy guard's check-and-set so the modifier no longer blocks reentrancy.
Remove the reset of the lock flag after the guarded body, so the second call to withdraw always reverts.
